International Cheese Federation Events Archive
This page serves as an archive or listing of events organized by the International Cheese Federation, detailing various workshops and webinars on topics such as curd retailing, affinage, judging standards, food safety, and packaging for cheese producers. It highlights past and upcoming educational opportunities for members.

Registration is closing on the Meadow Affinage workshop 

 

Our late-May affinage workshop in British Columbia has a handful of seats left. Here’s what six weeks in a working cave actually covers, and why the deadline is firmer than usual.
